title: RESIDE ITS local measurement physical-mapping supplement
rationale: The archived first attempt measured zero scenes because it required haze and transmission filename stems to match, although the qualified ITS layout guarantees only same-scene groups of ten. This adjacent second attempt preserves the deterministic 1,000-scene definition sample, all 1,000 validation scenes, three severities, scene-level independence, q metric, negative control, and thresholds. It changes only the mapping: each selected transmission is paired to the unique minimum-RMSE haze among the ten same-scene candidates under the synthetic atmospheric model. Passing authorizes only official ConvIR-B indoor baseline behavior measurement; outdoor and real-haze calibration remain mandatory independent stages.

scientific_contract.question: After replacing only the invalid filename-stem join with the frozen physical reconstruction mapping, do independent synthetic indoor ITS validation scenes recover controlled local q direction while paired transmission beats a cross-scene permutation negative control?

intervention.reference: known Y_alpha equals J plus alpha times I minus J
intervention.matched_budget: same frozen scenes, three transmission-selected severities, fixed resolution, alpha grid, and cross-scene negative control as the archived first attempt
fixed_factors: constant RGB airlight fit under I=J*t+A*(1-t)

primary_estimand.metric: proportion of validation clear scenes satisfying complete unique physical mapping, controlled q recovery, and paired-transmission separation
primary_estimand.aggregation: scene-clustered proportion with a two-sided 95 percent Wilson interval

controls: deterministic cross-scene transmission permutation within split and severity
separate absolute-error handling for low-denominator near-clear regions
brightness, gradient, and saturation association audit
unique minimum reconstruction RMSE among all ten same-scene haze candidates

uncertainty.method: scene-clustered proportions with two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals; nested variants, mapping candidates, and regions never increase n

gates.estimand: independent ITS validation scenes completed with three unique physical mappings
selected validation transmissions with a unique minimum-RMSE same-scene haze and three distinct mapped haze images per scene
canonical clear-scene overlap between sampled train and validation
Wilson lower bound for validation scenes with tau heavy-minus-light at least 0.05
Wilson lower bound for validation scenes with identifiable local q cells in all three severities
Wilson lower bound for validation scenes whose identifiable q cells recover every frozen alpha within 1e-5
Wilson lower bound for validation scenes where mapped true transmission lowers reconstruction RMSE by more than 0.005 versus cross-scene transmission for at least two severities
Wilson lower bound for the joint validation scene qualification proportion

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: The archived zero-scene result may be entirely due to the invalid filename-stem join. Even after physical mapping, apparent local sensitivity may remain an algebraic tautology or content-correlated transmission effect rather than a useful restoration-demand construct; controlled alpha recovery, permutation separation, and confound summaries address but do not eliminate that risk.
disabled_actions: training, inference, or official baseline evaluation
SOTS, Haze4K test, NH-HAZE, OTS, or outdoor data access
real-haze, outdoor, causal, perceptual-quality, or deployment extrapolation
treating mapping candidates, patches, regions, severities, or haze variants as independent samples
a third adjacent mapping supplement after fail or inconclusive

precision_contract.rationale: The unchanged full 1,000-scene validation census exceeds the frozen worst-case Bernoulli precision requirement.

precision.estimand: validation-scene measurement qualification proportion after frozen physical mapping
precision.source_reference: Worst-case Bernoulli standard deviation 0.5 fixed analytically before outcome access; sample and target are unchanged from the archived first attempt.
